skills.name: ar-latest-overdue-invoice
skills.title: Latest Overdue Invoice
skills.description: Find the most recent posted, unpaid overdue invoice.
skills.example_prompt: What is the latest overdue invoice?
when: Finding the single most recent posted, unpaid overdue invoice
Checking one overdue invoice quickly without a full report
steps: Return the most recent posted, unpaid overdue invoice that is not excluded.
Show invoice ID, customer, due date, days overdue, outstanding balance, status.

skills.name: ar-overdue-invoices
skills.title: AR Overdue Invoices
skills.example_prompt: Show my top 10 overdue invoices from last month.
when: Reviewing the largest posted, unpaid invoices that are past due
Preparing collections follow-up for a month or a days-overdue threshold
steps: Filter posted, unpaid invoices by the range.
Sort by amount descending and take the top N.
Show invoice number with link, amount and currency, due date, days past due, and the total.

skills.name: ar-pending-approval
skills.title: Invoices Pending Approval
when: Seeing how many invoices are waiting for approval
Getting links to each invoice that needs a decision
steps: Return all invoices pending approval.
Show count, plus invoice number with link for each.

skills.name: bills-due-soon
skills.title: Bills Due Soon SYNC EDIT
skills.description: Unpaid bills due within the next N days.
skills.example_prompt: Which bills are due in the next 10 days?
when: Planning cash outflow for the next few days
Finding bills with an early-payment discount about to expire
steps: List unpaid bills due in the window.
Include vendor, amount, due date, early-payment discount available.
Sum total cash outflow.

skills.name: contracts-upcoming-start
skills.title: Contracts Upcoming Start
skills.description: List contracts starting in the next N days.
skills.example_prompt: Which contracts start in the next 90 days?
when: Listing contracts about to start, by recognition start or first invoice date
Spotting contracts where the first invoice comes before recognition starts
steps: Find contracts with a performance obligation where either date falls in the window.
Show customer, contract ID, obligation, modules, value, first invoice date, recognition start.
Sort by first invoice date. Flag when first invoice precedes recognition start.

skills.name: deferred-revenue-by-entity

when: Reporting deferred revenue at a date, split by entity
Consolidating deferred revenue into the parent reporting currency
steps: By entity, split implementation from subscription.
Consolidate into the target currency.

skills.name: duplicate
skills.title: Duplicate
when: Seeing how many invoices are waiting for approval

steps: Return all invoices pending approval.

when: Finding upcoming invoices that include the Implementation module
Getting the dates those invoices will go out
steps: List invoices to be sent with that module in the window, with their dates.
Return the dates.

skills.name: intercompany-gl-report
skills.title: Intercompany GL Report

when: Producing an Excel report of posted intercompany ledger activity
Supporting intercompany review during close
steps: Pull posted intercompany activity from ledger data (not Report Center).
Columns: posting date, JE number, account, memo, debit, credit, source company, counterparty company, currency.
File name: Intercompany General Ledger Report.

skills.name: latest-posted-bill
skills.title: Latest Posted Bill
skills.description: Find the most recent posted bill, optionally for a vendor or entity.
skills.example_prompt: What is the latest posted bill?
when: Finding the most recent posted bill, for any vendor or one you name
Looking up a bill by vendor or entity without giving a date
steps: Return the latest posted bill: number, vendor, date, currency, company, expense account, total.

skills.name: unpaid-bills-list
